name: Leeds United 2019/20
scopeNote: EFL Championship (champions, 93 points, promoted), FA Cup and EFL Cup 2019/20: 49 competitive matches (Championship 46, FA Cup 1, EFL Cup 2). First match Bristol City 1-3 Leeds (Championship, 4 Aug 2019, English Wikipedia); last match Leeds 4-0 Charlton (22 Jul 2020). Marcelo Bielsa (id marcelo-bielsa) managed throughout. Style named by the evidence: a high, man-oriented press ('mark man-to-man across the pitch', Fantasy Football Scout quoting Coaches' Voice, 2020; 'partial man-marking', Total Football Analysis, May 2020) from a 4-1-4-1 (36 of 46 league games, Premier League/Opta) that becomes a 3-3-1-3 with a spare man at the back; about 60% possession. Wikipedia read to character 200000 of 214706; the last part (not relevant to the dates) was unread.
openQuestions: Marking: sources say man-to-man across the pitch with a spare man (FFS quoting Coaches' Voice, TFA 'partial man-marking'), but none gives a 2019/20-specific zonal/man breakdown by phase. The FourFourTwo spare-man piece could not be read.
No 2019/20 source read covers set pieces (a search found only 2018/19 and 2020/21 material), player profile or people management.
Wikipedia gives the first match as 4 Aug 2019 (a Sunday); confirm against the club or EFL fixture list if exactness matters.
Opponent-based shape changes (4-1-4-1 v one striker, 3-3-1-3 v two) rest on one analyst quote in a tier C page.

sources.title: 2019–20 Leeds United F.C. season
sources.evidence: Read to character 200000 of 214706. Loans in: Jack Harrison (Manchester City, 1 Jul 2019-30 Jun 2020), Ben White (Brighton, same period), Hélder Costa (Wolves), Illan Meslier (Lorient, from 8 Aug 2019), Eddie Nketiah (Arsenal, from 1 Jan 2020), Jean-Kévin Augustin (RB Leipzig, 27 Jan-30 Jun 2020). Out in summer 2019: Jack Clarke (Tottenham, £11m), Pontus Jansson (Brentford, £5.5m), Kemar Roofe (Anderlecht, £7m), Samuel Sáiz (Girona). Period and counts: first match Bristol City 1-3 Leeds (4 Aug 2019); last Leeds 4-0 Charlton (22 Jul 2020); Championship 46 (1st, 93 pts, 28W 9D 9L, 77-35), FA Cup 1 (Arsenal 1-0 Leeds, 6 Jan 2020), EFL Cup 2 (Salford 0-3 Leeds; Leeds 2-2 Stoke, lost 4-5 on penalties). 49 matches.
